Selected outside sources

Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • Counterfactual regret minimization: original paper

    NeurIPS / Zinkevich and colleagues · Free · Research paper

    The 2007 publication introducing counterfactual regret and a method for solving large imperfect-information games.

    Before you use it: Publication page and abstract read, not a proof audit or reproduction. Equilibrium conclusions require the paper's game assumptions.

    Public page read · 2026-10-08 · Full listing

  • PokerKit documentation

    PokerKit · Free · Documentation

    Documentation for a Python library covering poker game simulation, hand evaluation, and analysis.

    Before you use it: Research and development resource. Its implementation was not audited for this directory.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • Poker Hand History file format specification

    Juho Kim / PHH project · Free · Specification

    A human-readable, machine-parsable format for recording poker hands across variants, with required fields, notation, and examples.

    Before you use it: The format documents records; it cannot establish that a hand actually happened. Keep private participant details out of shared examples.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

Keep the scope in view

A starting point, not a complete course.

These guides and sources also appear elsewhere in the catalogue. Cross-listing them does not add to the resource count. Selected sources are editorial starting points, not performance rankings or paid placements. Use study material away from play, and check the linked publisher for current details.

Read the coverage limits, check the resource review policy or suggest a correction or missing source. Gambling-support resources are available without searching.
